diagnosis: The endpoint retrieves recently dispatched fan-out notification events from a Redis list fanout_history:{topic_key} based purely on topic_key from the URL path. It fails to check if current_user belongs to the organization or team that owns topic_key, exposing historical notification payloads that may contain one-time passwords, sensitive billing alerts, and system invitations.
exploit_request:
GET /notifications/fanout/topics/org_stellar_payroll/buffered-events HTTP/1.1
Host: push.cloudnotify.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
